I checked the official dates.

- The UK moved from BST back to GMT on Sunday 25 October 2026. ([gov.uk](https://www.gov.uk/when-do-the-clocks-change?hss_channel=tw-89465662&utm_source=openai))  
- The US (America/New_York) switches from DST to standard time on Sunday 1 November 2026. ([nist.gov](https://www.nist.gov/pml/time-and-frequency-division/popular-links/daylight-saving-time-dst?utm_source=openai)
